title: Pi settings merge
responsibility: Merge only Kiln's owned fields into the project's `.pi/settings.json` - the local package entry, the skill-override path `../planning-content/skills-overrides`, the selected default provider, model and thinking level, and `sessionDir: ".pi/sessions"` when project-local state is selected (removing Kiln's owned `sessionDir` when it is not, so no external path is committed) - preserving every unrelated key, package entry and unknown Pi or third-party field, refusing malformed JSON, a non-object root or an invalid value in a Kiln-owned field rather than replacing the file, preserving the file's trailing-newline style, and changing no bytes when the desired state is already present.
notes: ⚠️ THE FILE HAS TWO AUTHORS. `pi install -l` writes it and so does Kiln, and it is also a file the operator may hand-edit. Every one of those is a legitimate writer, so the merge is the boundary: Kiln owns four keys and must be able to prove it touched nothing else. ⚠️ NO SECRET EVER LANDS HERE. This file is committed on purpose, which is exactly why an API key, an OAuth token or an absolute home path reaching it is a disclosure rather than an untidiness. ⚠️ THERE IS NO SCHEMA VERSION TO CHECK. Pi's settings format has no version field, so the earlier requirement to refuse an unknown schema version had nothing to read; what is refused is malformed JSON, a non-object root, or an invalid value in a field Kiln owns, and every unknown field is kept. ⚠️ WRITER ORDER FOR THE PACKAGE ENTRY: `pi install -l` creates the literal entry; TSK-0030 proves canonical equivalence and chooses the portable spelling; TSK-0029's merge is the only mechanism that writes that decision, preserving every other entry. ⚠️ PI'S OWN LOCK IS HONOURED. Pi saves project settings under a `proper-lockfile` lock on the file, re-reading it and writing in place, and Kiln's transaction lock does not block it - so a Pi save landing between Kiln's final identity check and its rename would be lost. The merge takes the same `proper-lockfile` lock, as a direct pinned dependency, across that final check and the atomic write, without importing Pi's unexported storage class. ⚠️ TRAILING NEWLINE FOLLOWS THE FILE. Pi writes none; a merge that added one would change bytes on every alternation with a Pi save. An existing file keeps its style and a new file has none. ⚠️ THE SKILL OVERRIDE IS OBSERVED, NOT ASSUMED: EVD-0081 recorded a consumer override directory registered through the settings `skills` array loading instead of the packaged skill, and the packaged skill loading when it was removed.
